platform: Release Music Magazine Promotion Material Submission Route
manual_review_reason: Release Music Magazine's official Contact page expressly welcomes artists and other music-industry parties to send information and promotion material to its central info address or Gothenburg postal address. The address is repeated on the official Staff page, which says not to use old named staff addresses. The magazine does not publish accepted audio formats, attachment limits, download-link requirements, metadata fields, release windows, explicit-content rules, AI-origin policy or response timing. A human must select a genuinely relevant MarcsMusic alternative/electronic release, prepare a concise editorial pitch, prefer public streaming and permissioned download links over unsolicited large attachments, and verify the live requirements before sending. Do not contact individual writers, use deprecated addresses, submit through both email and post, or proceed if a login, CAPTCHA, payment, consent or protected workflow appears.
